Class XmlTierLinkType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlTierLinkType
public class XmlTierLinkType extends Object
Link to external reference with optional type

Java class for tierLinkType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="tierLinkType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <attribute name="href" use="required" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyURI" />
       <attribute name="label" type="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}nonemptyStringType" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>
